en.headline: Environment chief outlines 24-hour smart recycling and clean energy goals
en.dek: Secretary Tse Chin-wan said the government will expand community recycling with round-the-clock automated points and aims to raise the share of zero-carbon energy to 60 to 70 per cent by 2035.
body: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said on Saturday that Hong Kong will strengthen its community recycling network after the waste-charging scheme was shelved, including through 24-hour smart recycling bins and machines.

Speaking on Commercial Radio, Tse said the Green@Community mobile app now has 1.2 million users. He noted that some people recycle for rewards while others do so because they understand the need to reduce waste, and that greater convenience should encourage more participation.

Tse expressed confidence in meeting the four binding environmental targets in Hong Kong’s first five-year plan. These cover reducing carbon intensity, raising the share of zero-carbon energy in power generation, and improving air and surface water quality.

He said the share of zero-carbon energy, currently about 25 per cent, is targeted to reach 30 per cent by 2030 and 60 to 70 per cent by 2035. A large-scale facility is planned at Tseung Kwan O to transmit zero-carbon energy from the mainland, and a working group has been set up to discuss supplies with enterprises.

Tse also said the government would review the permitted profit levels of the two power companies when their control agreements expire in 2033. The zero-landfill goal by 2035 remains, he added, with the earlier waste-charging debate having raised public awareness of the need to cut rubbish.

zh.headline: 環境局長：推24小時智能回收 目標2035年零碳電力達六至七成
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，政府將加強社區回收網絡，包括推出24小時智能回收桶，並有信心達至2035年零碳能源佔比六至七成的目標。
body: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰周六表示，垃圾徵費計劃擱置後，政府將加強社區回收網絡，包括利用24小時智能回收桶及機器提升便利性。
謝展寰在商台節目中說，「綠在區區」手機應用程式現有120萬用戶。他指出，部分市民因獎賞而參與回收，亦有人因明白減廢需要而主動參與，相信提升便利程度後，會有更多人願意回收。
謝展寰表示有信心達成香港第一個五年規劃內四項具約束力的環保目標，包括降低碳強度、提升發電中零碳能源比例，以及改善空氣及地表水質。
他說，零碳能源現時約佔25%，目標2030年達30%，2035年再提升至60%至70%。政府計劃在將軍澳興建大型設施，大規模輸入內地零碳能源，並已成立工作小組與企業商討供應安排。
謝展寰又表示，兩電管制協議2033年屆滿時，政府會檢討許可利潤水平。2035年零堆填目標維持不變，他補充，早前垃圾徵費討論已提高市民對減廢的意識。
